title: A variable cannot have the name of a table of the model
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR Sales = 1 RETURN Sales + 1 )

expected.error: Sales is the name of a table, so it cannot be a variable name

source.quote: Names of existing tables aren't allowed.
source.supports: a variable name cannot be a table name

source.quote: The variable name cannot be a table name or a reserved keyword in DAX or MDX.
source.supports: a variable name cannot be a table name

derivation: The model has a table named Sales, so VAR Sales is not allowed and the query fails.
